pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql adds done NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with CHECK; test/done.test.js 'AC-1' checks existing rows are 0 and the CHECK rejects 2.
test 'AC-2' checks / and ?view=open list only open items in id order.
test 'AC-3' marks 3 then 1 done and expects ['✓ First item','✓ Third item'] in id order.
test 'AC-4' checks all items in id order with ✓ only on done ones.
test 'AC-5' checks the exact nav for each view and for /, current view is <strong>, not a link.
test 'AC-6' checks 400 and no <li> for Open, closed, empty and __proto__; src uses Object.hasOwn.

The behaviour is implemented and the test body covers it, but the last commit (6ffd805 'Follow-up edits') removed 'AC-7:' from the test title. No test now names AC-7, and the spec does not mark it 'verified by review'. Under the naming rule the item is unmet.
traffic/routes.json lists /?view=done and /?view=all; test 'AC-8' asserts both are in the file.

findings.what: Commit 6ffd805 ('Follow-up edits', by a bot, with no explanation) renamed the AC-7 test and dropped its 'AC-7' tag. No test names AC-7 now, and the spec has no 'verified by review' step for it. The PR says nothing about this edit.
findings.fix: Restore 'AC-7:' in the test title. Rewording a test's name must not cost an acceptance item its traceability.

findings.what: The PR says 'Tests deleted or loosened: none', but the last commit changed a test title so that it no longer names its acceptance item. The body also does not mention the 'Follow-up edits' commit.
findings.fix: Revert the rename and keep the body accurate about every commit.

findings.what: The fake app now keys its answers and the recorded paths on pathname plus search. No test asserts that the traffic worker actually requests the query routes.
findings.fix: Add a traffic-worker test asserting that the paths seen include /?view=done and /?view=all.

lenses.note: The spec has a go, dated 2026-10-12. The decisions are followed: the list opens on open items and the view is a query parameter. Nothing beyond the ask, apart from the traffic-check regex relaxation that AC-8 needs.
All six States rows have a test. AC-7 lost its name in the last commit.
The tests assert behaviour, not text. The AC-7 tag was removed. I did not run the suite; CI runs it on every push.
README describes the views and matches the code.
Logic is correct. Object.hasOwn guards __proto__, the SQL is built only from static fragments, and the empty-table check works.
The view value is whitelisted and titles are escaped. Nothing injected.
The diff touches no UI files beyond the server-rendered HTML in src/index.js, and no styles or client assets.
No browser flow or screenshots exist for this change; the page is plain server-rendered HTML.
The 'loosened: none' claim is inaccurate given the test rename, and the follow-up commit is not mentioned.
